notes: Identity verified from supplied full primary Research Report: title The Price Had Better Be Right: Women’s Reactions to Sexual Stimuli Vary With Market Factors; authors Kathleen D. Vohs, Jaideep Sengupta, Darren W. Dahl; DOI 10.1177/0956797613502732; Psychological Science 2014, 25(1), 278–283, online November 2013. Complete article through references. No PDF supplied; no rendering performed. Only assigned n_o and es_value_o evaluated; all unassigned fields are placeholders. Effect metric preserved exactly as canonical notation without conversion. The design identifies 87 sexual-condition participants, but does not explicitly give the final analytic count for negative affect; its denominator df differs from the ad-attitude analysis. No N derived from df. Candidate N: 87 sexual-condition participants. Same-test printed p = .059. The target is the negative-affect interaction; the positive-affect analysis is a different outcome. Negative affect has denominator df 82, while ad attitudes has 83, without an explanation of missingness.
